import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
flags = json.loads(Path('config/build.json').read_text())
result = sorted(k for k, v in flags.items() if v is True)
Path('reports').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('reports/build-flags.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
